notes: One sound designer per scene writes this file (work/<round>/mix-add-<scene>.json) and never edits audio/mix-events.json. The controller checks it with audit-mix-buses.py --events and merges all scenes at once with merge-mix-proposals.py. Every `match` must hit exactly one existing event of this scene, or nothing is merged. Event keys are the mix-events keys; `scene` is filled in when missing. Put bed gain fixes in the file (normalize the source), not +16 dB here.
